title: TrafficFab: An Autonomic Edge-Cloud Testbed Fabric forAI-Driven Traffic Management
summary: Traffic management in emerging megacities requires real-time analytics over thousands of CCTV video streams under latency, bandwidth, compute and energy constraints. We present TrafficFab, an autonomic edge--cloud testbed for AI-driven traffic management, designed to validate a representative slice of a megacity deployment. TrafficFab combines RTSP stream emulation, heterogeneous edge inference using DNNs, cloud-based nowcasting and forecasting using Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network (ST-GNN)
